item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.3 adds source modeling for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue, and updates several GitHub Actions queries for better accuracy. It is a CodeQL release used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door edge actions
item.description:
Azure Front Door edge actions are now in public preview. They let customers run lightweight JavaScript during request processing at the edge for real-time decisions closer to users.

  • Source: Azure Updates
